chunks: As for those they call besides God, they cannot create a thing, and have themselves been created.
ai.seo_question: Why are false deities considered unworthy of worship because they are created?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ontological distinction between the Necessary Being (Wajib al-Wujud) and contingent beings, emphasizing that idols are not only powerless but also subject to decay and death. This reinforces the concept of Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah by demonstrating that worship is due solely to the One who creates, whereas false deities are merely created entities incapable of independent action or sustenance.
